extracted.intended_audience: prospective scholarship/program applicants, students, and higher-education professionals searching IIE programs
extracted.subtask_description: Directory/listing page for IIE-managed scholarships, grants, and programs with short descriptions highlighting program goals, target participants, and illustrative outcomes. Used to discover opportunities and learn program aims and eligibility at a glance.

rubrics_metrics.name: The Language Flagship — target participants and goal
rubrics_metrics.description: "The Language Flagship is a multi-year program designed to guide talented undergraduate students enrolled full-time at a Flagship college or university in any major(s) toward graduating with professional-level proficiency in a language critical to U.S. national security."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Eligibility/target: talented full-time undergraduates at designated Flagship institutions, any major; multi-year commitment with the explicit outcome of professional-level language proficiency in a language deemed critical to U.S. national security.

rubrics_metrics.name: IIE Emergency Student Fund — purpose and target use
rubrics_metrics.description: "IIE Has Awarded 3,000+ Grants Since 2010, Allowing Students to Quickly Meet Their Immediate Educational Expenses" (presented as "IIE’s Emergency Student Fund: Micro Grants with a Big Impact").
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Program purpose: provide small, rapid-response grants to cover immediate educational expenses; design metric: speed and direct impact on a student's ability to continue studies (illustrated by an example recipient).

rubrics_metrics.name: Validating research findings with participants (research practice)
rubrics_metrics.description: "Presenting Findings to Respondents Transforms Them from Subjects to Trusted Partners... validating findings with participants in my research is one of the most rewarding and necessary aspects of data collection, especially on sensitive topics such as war and displacement."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recommended practice: follow up with research participants to present and validate findings; purpose is ethical rigor, participant trust-building, and improving data validity—especially important for sensitive contexts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Academic diplomacy via institutional delegations
rubrics_metrics.description: "IIE Led a Delegation to Connect U.S. and Vietnamese Higher Education Administrators... The delegation is part of the Center’s flagship program, the International..."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Program objective/metric: use institutional delegations to foster connections between higher-education administrators across countries; success indicated by strengthened bilateral academic relationships and follow-on collaborations supported by funders (e.g., missions).

rubrics_metrics.name: Global partnership outcomes: scholarship administration & leadership development
rubrics_metrics.description: "support in support of higher education scholarship administration, leadership development, and critical development in the region." (describing Montclair State University and Somaiya Vidyavihar University partnership).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Partnership evaluation criteria: contributions to scholarship administration capacity, leadership development, and regional development; long-term institutional relationship-building as a success indicator.

rubrics_metrics.name: Study abroad value: applied learning, international perspective, career discovery
rubrics_metrics.description: "Studying abroad is one of the best ways to apply classroom learning, acquire international perspectives, and discover career pathways."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Program/experience outcomes to emphasize and measure: application of coursework in real-world contexts, development of global perspectives, and identification or advancement of career pathways for participating students (illustrated by a student reflection).

rubrics_metrics.name: Career readiness — connecting global learning to workforce skills
rubrics_metrics.description: "Higher Education Professionals Focus on Connecting Global Learning with Workforce Skills... Career readiness is more than just a buzzword – it’s a critical component of a student’s educational journey."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Program design/evaluation criterion: ensure international/global learning initiatives explicitly develop workforce-relevant skills; assess whether programs improve career readiness as a central outcome.

rubrics_metrics.name: Widening access and innovation as award criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: Description of Lone Star College receiving an Andrew Heiskell Award for Innovation in International Education in the category of 'Widening Access to International Education' for its Global EdVantage initiative.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Award/recognition criteria implied: demonstrable innovation in international education and measurable widening of access to study abroad or international programs (e.g., scaling program reach, institutional growth, increased participation among underserved students).

rubrics_metrics.name: Program design elements to address workforce shortages (tri-lateral nursing partnership)
rubrics_metrics.description: "Partnership Leverages Micro-Credentials, Exam Prep, and Employment Opportunities... formalizes a study and training program to help fill the nursing shortage across..."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Design/effectiveness criteria: incorporate micro-credentials, targeted exam preparation, and direct employment pathways to address sector workforce shortages; success measured by credential attainment, exam pass rates, and employment placement.
